responsibility: Supplies the common Linux/ELF operating-system layer for PA-RISC. It installs Linux preprocessor builtins and driver specs, names the dynamic linker, defines ELF/GAS-oriented label and jump-table assembly conventions, customizes function declaration/prologue output for Linux assembly, marks sync compare-and-swap capabilities exposed through libcalls, and disables GNU-stack notes because PA Linux needs an executable stack for signal/syscall handling.
